facades.name: Jan Evertsenstraat street front (w02)
facades.note: Ground storey: fourteen bays between dark columns, the fourth from the east end a dark door bay, the two at the west end the PUCK shopfront. Three window bands of fourteen bays each between the pebble-concrete parapets (the tree hides the middle three in the upper two bands). The yellow entrance block east of the span and the stair west of it are left out.
